fusions.name: Snout First
fusions.desc: A ramming blow that deals 14 damage, knocks the target back 3.5 tiles and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: Over the Edge
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 22 damage to an enemy at or below 25% health and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. It can only strike a target that low.

fusions.name: Unmoved Hide
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 10 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Stood Ground
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
